title: JavaScript Certification Test (Domain 1)
instructions: You have only one chance to attempt this test. Once submitted, it cannot be retaken.

questions.text: A developer adds JavaScript directly inside an HTML button using onclick. As the project grows, the code becomes difficult to maintain. Which scripting approach is being used?
A company wants to reuse the same JavaScript file across multiple web pages and benefit from browser caching. Which approach should be implemented?
A webpage throws 'undefined element' errors because JavaScript executes before the DOM loads. What is the best practice to resolve this?
Two script files are included: a.js and b.js. File b.js depends on variables declared in a.js. How should they be ordered?
A web application stops executing when an undefined variable is accessed. Which feature allows the developer to handle the error gracefully?
A developer wants certain cleanup code to run whether or not an error occurs. Which block should be used?
In a financial application, division by zero must immediately stop execution with a custom message. Which statement should be used?
A developer needs to access the error name and message when handling exceptions. Which object provides these properties?
Accessing a variable that was never declared results in which type of error?
A website displays a welcome popup message when loaded. Which BOM method is most appropriate?
A payment system opens a new tab for transaction processing. Which method is used?
A developer schedules a function to execute once after 5 seconds. Which method should be used?
A repeating timer must be stopped once a counter reaches 5. Which function stops the interval?
A variable declared using var is accessed via window.variableName. Why is this possible?
options: var attaches to the window object globally
let behaves the same as var

questions.text: A developer wants to detect a user's screen resolution to optimize layout. Which object provides this information?
An analytics tool detects the user's browser language to localize content. Which property should be used?
A web app displays an 'Offline Mode' message when the internet connection is lost. Which property can detect this?
Why are alert(), confirm(), and prompt() discouraged in modern UX design?
Which statement best describes the Browser Object Model (BOM)?
A developer logs detailed browser and OS information for debugging purposes. Which property provides complete details?
Which timing function executes code repeatedly at fixed time intervals?
A developer updates a shopping cart total using score += 5. What does this operator do?
A developer accidentally writes a =+ 5 instead of a += 5. What happens?
A developer enables strict mode and writes x = 10;. What happens?
options: Throws error because x is not declared

questions.text: Which operator returns the remainder of a division?
A developer needs to pause execution to inspect variables in DevTools. Which keyword should be used?
You have an external JS file called logic located inside a folder named script. What is the proper reference to include this file?
If console.log() is used in both an inline script and an external script, which statement is correct?
options: It depends upon order of placement
